const.name: Primary OFF rod route
components: OFF cone bipolar / OFF output circuitry
const.interpretation: Candidate route-level mechanism from the reviewed circuit schematics; individual synapses and every possible AII output are not separately certified.

const.name: Secondary OFF rod route
components: OFF cone bipolar / OFF output circuitry
const.interpretation: Candidate route via rod-cone coupling; a signal contribution is conditional on the preparation and stimulus.

const.name: Tertiary OFF rod route
components: direct input to an OFF cone bipolar cell
const.interpretation: Candidate bypass of rod bipolar and rod-cone routes; residual responses alone may not identify it.

const.name: Secondary and/or tertiary routing
const.interpretation: Inclusive OR. Support for this combined candidate cannot be assigned to either member without discriminating evidence.

const.exposure: The existing retinal pilot, Grimes 2018 and Jin 2022 abstracts, selected Results/Methods and the Grimes Figure 6 workbook were inspected before this policy. This is an internal retrospective reconstruction, not a preregistered or held-out test.
const.scope: Compare specified OFF retinal-output routing experiments. Do not pool species, RGC classes, genotype contrasts, stimulus protocols or adaptation histories.
evidenceRules: Every context is a complete comparison protocol: its baseline and intervention arms must be read jointly. A context ID is not an individual treatment state or animal identity.
Bind each operating relation to complete experimental context IDs in addition to publication IDs. A publication containing several species is not one compatible preparation.

Represent each supported bridge as an aggregate light-drive-to-output functional relation. Candidate route decompositions are explanatory records, not separately measured synapses or physical construction rules.
Primary, secondary and tertiary routes are candidates; the non-primary candidate is an inclusive OR of secondary and tertiary. Supporting this disjunction does not identify either component.
Pharmacological and constitutive genetic contrasts have their declared specificity limits. Neither is represented as a perfect graph-edge deletion.
Keep mean background and flash intensity distinct despite their shared R*/rod/s unit; preserve nominal prose values separately from spreadsheet coordinates.
Replay published Figure 6F summary ratios without inventing sample-level data, standard errors, causal weights or carrier-count thresholds.
Existing publication-only fragments cannot participate in a context-qualified path. For a path, require a single complete context shared by every relation; pairwise overlap is insufficient.

Each case declares which route candidates the selected contrast can identify; unsupported disjunction-to-member promotion is rejected. These bounds are retrospective curation decisions, not an automatic biological identification theorem.

Unknown parameters remain explicit null values with named limitations, never wildcards or borrowed values from a nearby experiment. Complete context records do not imply a fully specified replication protocol.
const.acceptance: Eight complete contexts, three aggregate functional relations, six exact spreadsheet rows, all four route candidates adjudicated in each context, negative contract tests and reproducible current output.
limits: No complete toad-to-primate or cross-publication cascade is admitted.
No developmental generation, exhaustive minimality, independent prediction, geometric advantage or physical CRT promotion is established.
